ratings.comment: Professor Miller is very kind and understanding! She responds promptly to emails and in accessible outside of class. Much of the lectures rely on the readings, but they're interesting and worth the time in my opinion. Talk to her if you have any concerns and don't use your phone in class!

Emily is hands down the best professor I ever had. I took two classes with her over two semesters and I had the same great experience both times. She was always caring, patient, and high-spirited. She was very relaxed on due dates and gave great feedback on my work.

Not always the nicest, very strict about putting your phone in your backpack. Didn't show up for the first month of school, then showed up and didn't give a warm introduction. came in and started bossing people around right away. Good intensions, just not the most fun person. Very easy class but not very entertaining.

Dr. Miller gave really thorough lectures! Most of the time, you didn't even need to read the texts, but occasionally she would spring in-class assignments that were essentially just quizzes about the assigned readings. These were few and far between, however. Overall, a great professor. Also, there are no exams, just papers.
